release_notes: Ban 0.0.34: (1) To khai thue — ket qua tra cuu duoc LUU NGAY vao co so du lieu nen mo lai app khong phai tra cuu lai tu dau; cot 'Ma ho so' hien dung (truoc day doc sai ten truong cua cong); bam Tai lan hai se bo qua to khai da co tep tren may. (2) Tooltip — khong con hop tooltip vo nghia: bo tooltip lap lai dung chu dang hien tren bang va tren thanh menu doc, giu lai tooltip co thong tin that (ly do cong tu choi, ma CQT, canh bao). Them test tu dong cho ca hai viec.
